title: Ministries 3 of 4: the admin panel
question: Staff and leaders at a computer: the same management as the phone, wider. Which should I build?

options.label: The tree beside the ministry
options.lineage: the office's filing drawers beside the open file
options.thesis: Every ministry as a tree, the chosen one's tabs beside it, one person in a side panel.
options.viewport: Left: the tree with what's waiting; middle: Impact Kids' People tab as a table (age, parents, how reached, since); right: a sand panel for one child with Link a parent.
options.risk: Three columns need a wide window; under it the panel drops below.

options.label: A grid of ministries
options.thesis: A card per top ministry with its numbers and teams.
options.viewport: Cards for Music (teams as chips), Impact Kids (2 asking), Impact Youth, Life Groups, each with team, attendees, asking counts.
options.risk: Every task is a click deeper; sub-teams are only chips.

options.label: Who's waiting, across ministries
options.thesis: Columns of asks, invitations and young people without a parent, answered in place.
options.viewport: Asking (3) with Yes and No, Invited (2), Needs a parent (2) with Link a parent, across every ministry.
options.risk: A to-do, not the ministries themselves.
